sanity_checks.input: synthetic (competitor promotion, complaint-volume spike, fake internal survey, wrong margin-floor number -- none grounded in any play field)
sanity_checks.rationale_text: This play targets 368 units at DS-07. A competitor recently ran a similar promotion that failed, so we expect strong uptake. cite_or_drop_compliance.justification: The rationale invents numbers such as "94% satisfaction" and "45% floor" which are not traceable to any provided fields like `expected_outcome`, `guardrails`, or `policy_text`.

judge_result.overall_justification: The rationale is severely flawed, inventing multiple facts and numbers that are not supported by the play's data, and directly contradicting guardrail details.
